title: 第264章 “把这段也剪进去”，威龙是蛟龙特战队的人？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不可否认，在最开始的时候，飞龙的人确实是对威龙等一众“退伍老兵”有着轻视想法的。

因为能在他们这个年纪就成功退役，哪怕这或许是大众人十分常规的现象，

但是从刁钻一点的角度去看，这确实也代表了这个兵在各方面素质的平庸。

因为真正的强者是肯定会被部队想尽办法挽留住的。

除非是那种很特别的原因比如说家里老人年纪大了需要照顾等的情况，但这玩意总之也不可能特别多，

不可能说啪的一下有了五个，然后这五个又都刚好出现在他们飞龙的面前，

这个未免是有些抽象和不现实的。

但也是经过了刚才在体能上的比拼后，飞龙的人也不得不承认了这几个人的优秀，

开始真正重视起他们这一次的对手了！

他们是飞龙！是整个东部战区最锋锐的刀，如果真的会仅仅因为一次失败而对自己进行否定的话，

那他们干脆也别搞什么演武也不要上国际舞台了。

毕竟不可否认的是，人家欧美洲国家的大兵在这方面的天赋确实相对较好，

而在这种情况下想要赢的话，那就得比拼一下他们那边相对薄弱的方面，即脑子与战术了！

话题言归正传。

在刚才飞龙大队结束了对威龙的战前喊话后。

没有时间留给他们休息，本次演武的第二项比赛就正式来到了。

只不过由于他们这一次的“演武”本质上是为了给接下来的发布互联网的视频收集素材，

本质并不是真的要去搞什么演习。

所以在考虑到时间因素的情况下，他们选择了将剩下五个项目同时进行演练拍摄，

每一个项目也并非是需要集体参与而是两队各自只派出一人进行最为直观的单挑！

首先就是武装越野后的第一个项目——

基础力量组合检测！

参赛选手需要在接下来连续完成一整个综合力量作训组，即——

一分钟的引体向上，两分钟的俯卧撑，和一分钟的标准深蹲！

在同样时间内，谁完成的次数越多就判谁赢！

“队长，这个项目就让我来吧！”

飞龙大队那边为了应对这个项目，派出了一个身材相对精干的士兵。

没错，虽然这一次的比赛项目的名称是综合力量作训组，但比的确实耐力与爆发力，

不是块头越大，肌肉越大就能取得更好成绩的。

就比方说他们这一次派出的这位，

如果说按照普通士兵的标准，

一分钟姿态正确的引体向上要求是8个，

团部尖子是21个，专业特种兵是30个的话。

他的巅峰成绩可是能在一分钟60秒的时间做到最高37个的！

当然了，鉴于巅峰成绩本身就不能作为参考，且那是全盛体力下去完成的，

现在刚跑完了五公里武装越野后体力肯定已经消耗了不少，但基本上也是能一分钟完成三十个，

相当于是两秒钟一个，超越了一般特种部队在全省状态下要求的！

“一！二！三....”

“二十....二十五....二十九....三十！三十一！”

“三十二！”

“好！”

当身旁的裁判员按下了手中的计时器并宣布计时开始，飞龙队员立马就上杆拉起了最为标准的引体向上。

直到一分钟的计时结束，他甚至连气都不能喘足一口就立马开始了为时两分钟的俯卧撑，

俯卧撑之后还有深蹲。

最终，在一共四分钟的计时终于彻底结束，裁判员吹响令哨后。

飞龙这边的成绩也同步完成了阶段。

分别是：一分钟32个标准引体向上，两分钟共112个俯卧撑，一分钟140个深蹲！

可以看到，以基础力学作为基础理论，基本上是参与肌肉越多的项目，在短时间内的爆发做组数量就能越多。

而再考虑到这是在刚跑完五公里武装越野后的数据成绩，毫无疑问这已经是这位队员超常发挥后的结果，

是一个能抵达全战区前五到十名的超高成绩了！

“呼！呼！哈...哈哈！”

起身后，飞龙队员一边大口喘息着，一边脸上也露出了不负众望的笑容。

“干得漂亮！”

飞龙队长走了过来拍了拍他的肩膀，随后又将目光看向了威龙等人的方向。

Page (1/3)

It is undeniable that at the beginning, the people of Feilong did have contempt for Veyron and other "veterans".

Because they can successfully retire at their age, even though this may be a very common phenomenon for the general public,

But from a more subtle perspective, this does represent the mediocre quality of this soldier in all aspects.

Because the truly strong ones will definitely be retained by the army in every possible way.

Unless there is a very special reason, such as an elderly person in the family who needs care, etc., there are not likely to be too many of these.

It's impossible to say that there were five of them in one fell swoop, and then all five of them happened to appear in front of their flying dragon.

This is somewhat abstract and unrealistic.

But after the physical competition just now, the people in Feilong had to admit the excellence of these people.

They began to really pay attention to their opponent this time!

They are flying dragons!It is the sharpest knife in the entire eastern theater. If you really want to deny yourself just because of one failure,

Then they might as well stop engaging in martial arts and not go on the international stage.

After all, it is undeniable that soldiers from European and American countries are indeed relatively talented in this area.

And if you want to win in this situation, you have to compete with their relatively weak areas, that is, brains and tactics!

Let’s get down to business.

Just now, the Feilong Brigade finished its pre-war speech against Weilong.

There was no time left for them to rest, and the second competition of this martial arts performance officially arrived.

But because their "martial arts performance" this time is essentially to collect material for the next video to be released on the Internet,

The essence is not really to do any exercises.

Therefore, taking into account the time factor, they chose to conduct rehearsal shooting of the remaining five projects at the same time.

Each project does not require collective participation, but only one person from each team is sent for the most intuitive one-on-one challenge!

The first is the first project after armed cross-country——

Basic strength combination test!

Competitors need to complete an entire comprehensive strength training group in a row, namely——

One minute of pull-ups, two minutes of push-ups, and one minute of standard squats!

Whoever completes more times within the same time period will win!

"Captain, let me do this project!"

In order to deal with this project, the Feilong Brigade sent a relatively capable soldier.

Yes, although the name of this competition is Comprehensive Strength Training Group, the competition is really about endurance and explosive power.

It's not that being bigger or having bigger muscles will lead to better results.

For example, the person they sent this time,

If we go by the standards of ordinary soldiers,

The required number of pull-ups with correct posture is 8 in one minute.

If there are 21 top leaders in the regiment and 30 professional special forces.

His peak performance was a maximum of 37 in one minute and 60 seconds!

Of course, given that the peak performance itself cannot be used as a reference, and it was accomplished at full strength,

Now that I have just completed a five-kilometer armed cross-country run, my physical strength must have been exhausted a lot, but I can basically complete thirty in one minute.

It is equivalent to one every two seconds, which exceeds the requirements of ordinary special forces in the entire province!

"One! Two! Three..."

"Twenty...twenty-five...twenty-nine...thirty! Thirty-one!"

"Thirty-two!"

"Okay!"

When the referee next to him pressed the timer in his hand and announced that the timer had started, the Feilong players immediately pulled up the bar and performed the most standard pull-up.

When the one-minute timer expired, he couldn't even take a full breath before he immediately started doing push-ups for two minutes.

After push-ups there are squats.

Finally, after a total of four minutes, the timer finally ended and the referee blew the whistle.

Feilong's results also completed the stage simultaneously.

They are: 32 standard pull-ups in one minute, 112 push-ups in two minutes, and 140 squats in one minute!

It can be seen that using basic mechanics as the basic theory, basically the more muscles involved in an event, the more explosive sets you can do in a short period of time.

And considering that this is the data result just after running a five-kilometer armed cross-country, there is no doubt that this is the result of this team member’s extraordinary performance.

This is a super high result that can reach the top five to ten in the entire theater!

"Hoo! Hoo! Ha...haha!"

After getting up, the Feilong team members gasped for air while showing a smile that lived up to their expectations.

"Well done!"

Captain Feilong came over and patted his shoulder, then looked in the direction of Weilong and others.
